hook_line: SUPREME COURT TO DECIDE TRUMP ASYLUM BAN

hook_stat.sub: Ruling due by the end of June

stats.label: Lower courts held the categorical ban unlawful
Conservative majority on the Supreme Court

diaspora_bullets: H-1B, F-1 and green cards not in this case
Asylum bar stays in effect during appeal
news_summary: The US Supreme Court agreed on Friday to decide whether President Donald Trump's proclamation barring asylum claims at the southern border is legal.
payoff: The asylum bar continues until the court rules.
